protocol.scope: Isolated count patcher; unchanged Python LMDB/LRU callback and GPU input/output; no model weights loaded
protocol.changed: C++ token loop, probability/entropy/score, online counts and boundary/length state; no rule tuning
protocol.not_changed: Same Python LMDB background, 4096-row LRU, GPU.tolist input and torch.tensor output
protocol.cache_control: Separate identical LRU caches over one shared read-only LMDB transaction; clear both before each phase, then identical warmups
protocol.initial: One prefix forward ending 32 IDs before final length
protocol.incremental32: Identical 32 full-prefix calls after untimed priming; count state reused
protocol.excluded: Build/loading, adapter reset, priming, diagnostics, output copying for validation
protocol.bootstrap: Paired execution blocks, 2000 resamples, seed20261019; ratio of medians
protocol.limitations: Not pure interpreter overhead or theoretical maximum removal; C++ changes storage/layout and numeric reductions. Not full-model or generation speedup, no adoption claim.
